Test Title: Dynamic Token Creation with valid credentials
Test Steps:
1. Send POST request to /auth with valid admin credentials.
2. Verify status code is 200 OK.
3. Verify response JSON contains string token field.
Expected Response / Behavior: Response body contains {"token": "<string_token_value>"}.

Test Title: Create Token with invalid username
Test Steps:
1. Send POST request with invalid username.
2. Verify response status code and body message.
Expected Response / Behavior: Response body contains {"reason": "Bad credentials"}.

Test Title: Create Token with invalid password
Test Steps:
1. Send POST request with invalid password.
2. Verify response status code and body message.
Expected Response / Behavior: Response body contains {"reason": "Bad credentials"}.

Test Title: Create Token missing password field
Test Steps:
1. Send POST request missing password field.
2. Verify response body.
Expected Response / Behavior: Response body contains {"reason": "Bad credentials"}.

Test Title: Create Token with empty body payload
Test Steps:
1. Send POST request with empty JSON payload.
2. Verify response body.
Expected Response / Behavior: Response body contains {"reason": "Bad credentials"}.

Test Title: Dynamic Token Flow: Update booking using dynamic token
Pre-conditions: Valid dynamic token acquired from /auth; Booking ID exists.
Headers / Auth: Content-Type: application/json; Accept: application/json; Cookie: token=<token_value>
Test Steps:
1. Get token via POST /auth.
2. Create booking via POST /booking.
3. Send PUT request with Cookie: token=<token> header.
4. Verify update success.
Expected Response / Behavior: Response body returns updated booking with firstname 'DynamicJim'.

Test Title: Auth Bypass: Perform DELETE without Cookie or Auth header
Headers / Auth: No Auth Header or Cookie provided
Test Steps:
1. Create booking via POST /booking.
2. Send DELETE request without any authentication header.
3. Verify access rejection.
Expected Response / Behavior: Server returns HTTP 403 Forbidden.

Test Title: Auth Failure: Perform DELETE with invalid Cookie token
Test Steps:
1. Send DELETE request with invalid token string in Cookie header.
2. Verify access rejection.
Expected Response / Behavior: Server returns HTTP 403 Forbidden.

Test Title: Alternative Auth: Perform DELETE using Basic Auth header
Test Steps:
1. Create booking via POST /booking.
2. Send DELETE request with Basic Auth header.
3. Verify deletion success.
Expected Response / Behavior: Server returns HTTP 201 Created confirming deletion.

Test Title: Create a new booking with valid payload
Test Steps:
1. Send POST request to /booking with valid booking JSON payload.
2. Verify HTTP status code.
3. Verify bookingid is generated.
Expected Response / Behavior: Response contains generated bookingid and matching booking object.

Test Title: Boundary: Create booking with totalprice = 0
Test Steps:
1. Send POST request with totalprice = 0.
2. Verify response status code and totalprice value.
Expected Response / Behavior: Response body contains totalprice = 0.

Test Title: Boundary: Create booking with negative totalprice
Test Steps:
1. Send POST request with totalprice = -100.
2. Verify response status code.
Expected Response / Behavior: Server returns validation error 400 or handles negative price.

Test Title: Boundary: Create booking with large totalprice
Test Steps:
1. Send POST request with totalprice = 9999999.
2. Verify response status code and totalprice value.
Expected Response / Behavior: Response body contains totalprice = 9999999.

Test Title: Boundary: Create booking with depositpaid = false
Test Steps:
1. Send POST request with depositpaid = false.
2. Verify response depositpaid boolean value.
Expected Response / Behavior: Response body contains depositpaid = false.

Test Title: Boundary Date: Create booking with checkin == checkout
Test Steps:
1. Send POST request with checkin date equal to checkout date.
2. Verify status code.
Expected Response / Behavior: Server accepts same-day checkin/checkout with 200 OK.

Test Title: Boundary Date: Create booking with checkin after checkout
Test Steps:
1. Send POST request with checkin date later than checkout date.
2. Verify status code response.
Expected Response / Behavior: Server returns validation error 400 or accepts payload.

Test Title: Validation: Create booking missing required firstname
Test Steps:
1. Send POST request missing firstname field.
2. Verify response status code.
Expected Response / Behavior: Server returns HTTP 400 Bad Request or 500 Internal Server Error.

Test Title: Validation: Create booking missing bookingdates object
Test Steps:
1. Send POST request missing bookingdates object.
2. Verify response status code.
Expected Response / Behavior: Server returns HTTP 400 Bad Request or 500 Internal Server Error.

Test Title: Security: Create booking with XSS script in firstname
Test Steps:
1. Send POST request with XSS script tag in firstname field.
2. Verify response handles script string safely.
Expected Response / Behavior: Response retains text string without executing script payload.

Test Title: Get all booking IDs
Test Steps:
1. Send GET request to /booking.
2. Verify HTTP status code.
3. Verify response is a JSON array of objects containing bookingid.
Expected Response / Behavior: Returns JSON array of booking ID objects e.g. [{'bookingid': 1}, {'bookingid': 2}].

Test Title: Filter booking IDs by firstname and lastname
Test Steps:
1. Send GET request with firstname and lastname query filters.
2. Verify HTTP status code and array response.
Expected Response / Behavior: Returns JSON array of matching booking IDs.

Test Title: Filter booking IDs by checkin and checkout dates
Test Steps:
1. Send GET request with checkin/checkout date query filters.
2. Verify array response.
Expected Response / Behavior: Returns JSON array of matching booking IDs.

Test Title: Get booking by valid ID
Pre-conditions: Target booking ID exists on server.
Test Steps:
1. Create booking via POST /booking.
2. Send GET request to /booking/{id}.
3. Check response status code and properties.
Expected Response / Behavior: Returns booking object with firstname, lastname, totalprice, and bookingdates.

Test Title: Get booking by non-existent ID
Test Steps:
1. Send GET request to /booking/999999999.
2. Verify HTTP status code.
Expected Response / Behavior: Server returns HTTP 404 Not Found.

Test Title: Get booking by invalid string ID
Test Steps:
1. Send GET request with non-numeric string ID.
2. Verify status code response.
Expected Response / Behavior: Server returns HTTP 404 Not Found or 400 Bad Request.

Test Title: Full Update Booking (PUT) with token
Pre-conditions: Valid Auth Token acquired; Booking ID exists.
Headers / Auth: Content-Type: application/json; Accept: application/json; Cookie: token=<token>
Test Steps:
1. Create booking.
2. Send PUT request with complete updated booking payload and Cookie token header.
3. Verify update.
Expected Response / Behavior: Returns updated booking object with firstname 'UpdatedJim' and additionalneeds 'Lunch'.

Test Title: Partial Update Booking (PATCH) with token
Pre-conditions: Valid Auth Token acquired; Booking ID exists.
Headers / Auth: Content-Type: application/json; Accept: application/json; Cookie: token=<token>
Test Steps:
1. Create booking.
2. Send PATCH request with partial payload {'firstname': 'PatchedJim'} and Cookie token header.
3. Verify partial update.
Expected Response / Behavior: Returns booking object with updated firstname 'PatchedJim' while keeping other fields unchanged.

Test Title: Delete booking (DELETE) with token
Pre-conditions: Valid Auth Token acquired; Booking ID exists.
Test Steps:
1. Create booking.
2. Send DELETE request with Cookie token header.
3. Verify deletion status code.
Expected Response / Behavior: Server returns HTTP 201 Created confirming deletion.

Test Title: Delete non-existent booking ID
Test Steps:
1. Send DELETE request to non-existent ID 999999999.
2. Check HTTP status code.
Expected Response / Behavior: Server returns HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed or 404 Not Found.

Test Title: Ping Health Check
Test Steps:
1. Send GET request to /ping.
2. Verify status code and body content.
Expected Response / Behavior: Server returns HTTP 201 Created with text body 'Created'.
